senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; an adapt. and contr. of כּוּרְסַיָּא)bolsters, chair, throne.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:17">Ib. 17</cite> <he>אין יוצאין בכִּסֵּה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>בכסא</he>) you must not be carried out on a sedan chair (on Holy Days); <cite ref="Beitzah 25b:7">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ מה אתון ביה</he> what is your opinion about carrying a person on a chair &c.?—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:3">Kel. XXII, 3</cite> <he>הכ׳ שלפני קתידרא</he> the bolster in front of the cathedra (a kind of footstool).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:4">Ib. 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01424"><he>חִפּוּי</he></cite>; a. fr.—<he>כ׳ הכבוד</he> the throne of Divine Majesty.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:4">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>כ׳ הדין</he> the throne of Divine judgment; <he>כ׳ רחמים</he> mercy-seat.
Lev. R. s. 29 אני עומד מכ׳ הדין וכ׳ I rise from the throne of judgment and seat myself on the throne of mercy; a. fr.—Euphem. בית הכ׳ privy.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:1">Tam. I, 1</cite> <he>בית הכ׳ של כבוד</he> a chaste privy.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:4">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּסָּאוֹת</he>, <he>כִּסָּיוֹת</he>, <cite ref="K00030"><he>כִּי׳</he></cite>; with suff. <he>כִּסְאֵי־</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:17">Ex. R. s. 31</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 10:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X, 6</cite> <he>הכיסיות שבבימה</he> (not <he>הכו׳</he>) the (stationary) seats in public courts.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 24:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite> <he>עמדו מכִּסְאֵיהֶם</he> arose from their thrones.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 4:4">Zab. IV, 4</cite> <he>כסאות</he>, v. <cite ref="K00961"><he>כֶּסֶת</he></cite>.]
